method: client_ghost_baseline_ms() runs 10 repeated bounded BFS passes over the synth-500 bundle and returns the median wall-clock time. Live HydraDB p50/p95 require a running engine and are left null here rather than fabricated; re-measure with `scripts/bench_latency.py` against a live stack.

percentiles.note: Live HydraDB latency intentionally not fabricated. Run `scripts/bench_latency.py` with a live stack to populate these.

limitations: Fixture BFS time is measured in-process on the developer machine; actual time is hardware-dependent.
Live HydraDB p50/p95 requires a running engine and is intentionally not fabricated here.
The 124,750 client-equivalent round-trips assumes one shortest-path query per pair for 500 people.
